description:
Purpose: Find job postings that fit the user's role, location and fields, with a short summary per posting.
When: The user describes work they want; gather role and location first; in a chat app show results with job_postings_search_widget_render, unasked, and in a terminal as text.
Cost: About 170 tokens per posting and 3020 for 20 postings.

companies.description: Company names; a posting from any of them is kept.

datePosted.description: How recently the posting was published; leave it out for any date.

department.description: One department slug, to narrow a title that spans departments; call job_postings_search_fields for what each one holds.

excludeKeywords.description: Words that must not appear in the title or the text, 1 to 10 words.

experience.description: Experience level to keep, as exactly one of exact or min.

min.description: Keep this experience level and every level above it.

includeFamily.description: Also return postings from the resolved role's wider family; false, the default, keeps the exact role only.

includeNoSalary.description: Keep postings that publish no salary; true by default.

keywords.description: Words that must appear in the posting's text.

locations.description: Location names in plain words, each read as the closest known location, so check resolvedLocations for what was actually searched.

salaryMax.description: Highest yearly salary to keep, in US dollars after the same conversion.

salaryMin.description: Lowest yearly salary to keep, in US dollars after each posting's published salary is converted.

sortBy.description: Result order; job_postings_search_fields explains each value.

titleText.description: Words of the job title, matched to one of searchnapply's known roles (resolvedRole.display names it), else matched against posting titles.

name: job_postings_search

outputSchema.description: One page of job postings matching the search.

facets.description: How the matches split by department; absent on a narrowed or empty search.

departments.description: The largest departments among the matches, with their counts.

count.description: How many matching postings the department holds.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

familyLabel.description: The name of the role's wider family.

familyTotal.description: How many more postings the role's wider family holds; present when the exact result is short.

hint.description: What to do next when the result needs a decision or a retry.

pageSize.description: How many postings a page holds.

postings.description: The matching postings, one summary each.

department.description: The department the posting's role belongs to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

employmentType.description: The employment type, in the employmentType field's vocabulary.

experienceLevel.description: The experience level, in the experience field's vocabulary.

id.description: The posting id to pass to job_postings_get_full_description.

locationCount.description: How many locations the posting names in total.

locations.description: Up to five location names of the posting.

matchedVia.description: Which match found the row: exact, title or family.

postingUrl.description: The company's own posting, where the user applies.

publishedAt.description: When the company published the posting.

currency.description: The currency code the amounts are in.

period.description: The time the amounts cover, such as year or hour.

shortDescription.description: A one-line digest of the duties and skills, in the company's words.

title.description: The job title as the company wrote it.

workFormat.description: Where the work happens: remote, hybrid or on-site.

resolvedLocations.description: The locations that were searched, as resolved from the location names given.

display.description: The known location it was read as.

resolvedRole.description: The role the title words were read as; absent when no role matched.

ambiguous.description: True when the title names several departments.

candidates.description: The departments an ambiguous title could mean; present only when ambiguous.

items.description: One department an ambiguous title could mean.

department.description: The department slug of the role, for the department field.
The department the role belongs to.

slug.description: The department slug the department field takes.

display.description: The role's name, which the search ran on.

titleNote.description: Present when no role matched: the title words were matched against posting titles.

totalCount.description: How many postings match in total.

totalCountIsCapped.description: True when the count stopped at 1,000 and more postings match.

totalPages.description: How many pages the matches fill.

unrecognizedLocations.description: The location names that matched no known location and were left out.

title: Search job postings
